problem_description: Waiting period for obtaining a visa. I applied for a student visa - Germany, and I couldn’t get an appointment for months. My university offer was also at risk. After several tries of contact via emails and calls, I finally got my visa. However, I was 2 weeks late for the course. If I couldn’t make it for another 2 days, I would have lost my offer from the university abroad.
suggested_improvement: Optimizing the procedure of setting appointments. Block unauthorized appointment booking.

problem_description: Factories near the Kelani river in our area release waste water directly into the river. Sometimes the water changes colour and dead fish float. People downstream still use this water for bathing and washing.
suggested_improvement: Monitor factories and impose heavy fines for discharging untreated waste. Publish water quality test results.

problem_description: My phone was stolen in a bus and I went to the police station to make a complaint. I had to wait 3 hours to get it recorded. After that nobody followed up even though I gave the IMEI number. When I went again they said it is not a priority.
suggested_improvement: Allow online police complaints for minor crimes and give a reference number to track progress.

problem_description: My land case has been in court for 9 years. It is postponed on every court date. We are worn out from paying lawyers' fees.
suggested_improvement: Increase the number of judges so that cases are resolved quickly.

problem_description: My grandmother needs cataract surgery in both eyes. The government hospital put her on a waiting list and said it could take up to one year. She can barely see now and cannot go out alone. A private eye hospital quoted Rs. 100,000 for one eye, which we cannot afford.
suggested_improvement: Government should organise more eye surgery camps and reduce waiting lists for elderly patients. Maybe partner with private hospitals at a subsidised rate.

problem_description: Travelling from Kadawatha to Colombo Fort in the morning takes nearly 2 hours for a 20 km distance. The Kelaniya bridge area and Peliyagoda are completely blocked from 7 to 9 am. I waste around 4 hours every day in traffic and spend a lot on fuel.
suggested_improvement: Bus priority lanes should be properly enforced. Improve park and ride facilities and the railway so people leave their vehicles.

problem_description: Free textbooks and uniform material were received only in March this year, after the term started. Students had to share books or photocopy pages at their own cost.
suggested_improvement: Distribute textbooks and uniform material before the new school year begins.

problem_description: At the clinic in Gampaha District General Hospital the doctor prescribed five medicines for my mother's diabetes and blood pressure, but the hospital pharmacy only had two. We were told to buy the rest from a private pharmacy outside. It costs us about Rs. 4,500 every month. This has been happening for almost a year now and it is very hard for a family with one income.
suggested_improvement: The government should ensure regular supply of essential drugs to hospitals and publish a list of out-of-stock medicines so people can plan. State pharmacies (Osu Sala) should be expanded to more towns.

problem_description: I retired from government service as a teacher in January but my pension has still not started after 8 months. I have gone to the Pensions Department and the zonal office many times. Each office says the documents are with the other office.
suggested_improvement: Process pensions before the retirement date and introduce an online tracking system for pension files.

problem_description: The psychiatric clinic in our area only runs once a month and there is a very long queue. My brother needs regular follow up but the doctor only has a few minutes for each patient. There is also a lot of stigma so many people don't even come.
suggested_improvement: More mental health clinics and counsellors at divisional level, and awareness programmes to reduce stigma.

problem_description: I needed legal advice about my divorce and child maintenance but I could not afford a private lawyer. The Legal Aid Commission office is in the town and only open on certain days. When I went they said the officer was not available.
suggested_improvement: Expand legal aid services to divisional secretariat level and offer phone consultations.

problem_description: Government land was given to a few people in our village under a land permit scheme but there was no public list of who applied or how they were selected. Families who have been living there for 20 years did not get anything while some outsiders got land.
suggested_improvement: Publish the list of applicants and selection criteria for all land distribution programmes.

problem_description: In the female ward at Ratnapura hospital there were not enough beds so patients were sleeping on mats on the floor. The toilets were broken and very dirty, and there was no water in the evening. The fans in half the ward were not working.
suggested_improvement: Allocate funds for ward maintenance and cleaning. Increase bed capacity and assign a maintenance officer for each ward.

problem_description: My water bill this month was Rs. 9,800 when it is normally around Rs. 1,500. The meter reader did not come and the bill was estimated. When I complained they said I have to pay first and then it will be adjusted.
suggested_improvement: Bills should be based on actual meter readings. Introduce a way to submit a photo of the meter online.

problem_description: The fertilizer subsidy for paddy farmers came after the cultivation season had already started in Polonnaruwa. Farmers had to buy fertilizer from the market at a high price on credit. Now with low paddy prices at harvest we are in debt.
suggested_improvement: Release the fertilizer subsidy before the Maha and Yala seasons begin and set a guaranteed price for paddy.

problem_description: I applied for a new electricity connection for my house in Welimada six months ago and paid all the fees. CEB officers keep saying there is no meter stock.
suggested_improvement: Ensure meters are available and set a maximum time to give new connections.

problem_description: On government websites, a lot of information is only in Sinhala and English. There is no Tamil version, or the information in Tamil is out of date.
suggested_improvement: Information in Tamil should be updated on all government websites.

problem_description: In the flats where we live in Colombo 14 the sewage line overflows into the common area every few weeks. Children play near it. Complaints to the Municipal Council get a temporary fix but the problem returns.
suggested_improvement: Replace the old sewage system in the housing scheme permanently.

problem_description: Buses in the Colombo-Kandy route are packed beyond capacity during office hours. Pickpocketing and harassment of women is common because of the crowd. Conductors keep pushing more passengers in.
suggested_improvement: Limit the number of standing passengers and add more buses during rush hours. Install CCTV in buses.

problem_description: Private buses on our route near Matara skip halts and refuse to stop for students and elderly people. After 6.30 pm there are no buses at all to our village. CTB buses come only twice a day. People who work in town have to spend a lot on three-wheelers to come home at night.
suggested_improvement: Increase evening CTB services on rural routes and take action against private buses that skip halts. A complaint hotline that actually works would help.

problem_description: Because garbage is not collected, people in our area burn plastic and waste in their gardens every evening. The smoke comes into our house and my elderly mother has breathing problems.
suggested_improvement: Start regular collection and fine people who burn plastic.

problem_description: I graduated with a BA degree two years ago and still don't have a permanent job. I have applied for many government and private jobs. Most private jobs ask for experience or IT skills that we did not learn at university. Many graduates are doing three-wheeler driving or delivery jobs.
suggested_improvement: Align university courses with industry needs and provide internships and skill training programmes for unemployed graduates.

problem_description: I run a small bakery in Moratuwa. After the electricity tariff increases my monthly bill went from around Rs. 18,000 to over Rs. 45,000. I had to increase the prices and lost customers. Small businesses cannot survive with these rates.
suggested_improvement: Introduce a lower tariff for small businesses and support solar panel installation with loans.

problem_description: The main road in our village has been broken for 5 years. When it rains, the potholes fill with water and motorcycle accidents happen. Even three-wheelers are unwilling to come. Although we complained to the Pradeshiya Sabha several times, there has been no response at all.
suggested_improvement: Carpet the road quickly.

problem_description: My daughter went to the Middle East for housemaid work through an agency registered with SLBFE. She was not paid for 4 months and her passport was taken by the employer. When we complained to the Bureau it took weeks to get any response.
suggested_improvement: SLBFE should monitor agencies strictly, respond quickly to complaints and have embassy officers follow up workers regularly.

problem_description: My family was removed from the Aswesuma welfare list even though our situation has not changed. My husband is disabled and I do part time work. Some families in our village who own vehicles and good houses are getting the payment. When we appealed to the Divisional Secretariat they said the decision is from the system.
suggested_improvement: Re-check the Aswesuma selection properly through home visits and make the appeal process clear and fast.

problem_description: I sent three emails to a government department about my vehicle registration problem and also filled the contact form on their website. After one month I have not received any reply. The phone line is also never answered.
suggested_improvement: Assign staff to answer online inquiries within a fixed time and give a ticket number for tracking.

problem_description: At the outpatient department of Jaffna Teaching Hospital, even though we arrived at 7 in the morning, we had to wait until 1 in the afternoon. There is a shortage of doctors and nurses. This is very difficult for elderly people.
suggested_improvement: More doctors should be appointed. A token system should be introduced.

problem_description: The road from Gampola to our estate is very dangerous, there is a landslide risk and no guard rails on the bend. I already reported this,
suggested_improvement: Put guard rails and repair the edge of the road before the monsoon.

problem_description: evrything so expnsive now. bread, milk powder, gas all up. salary same since 3 yrs. how to live? govt only talk no action
suggested_improvement: reduce prices of basic food items

problem_description: In our village near Galgamuwa wild elephants come almost every night during harvest season. They destroyed our paddy field and coconut trees. Last year a farmer from the next village was killed. The electric fence is broken in several places and the Wildlife Department does not repair it on time.
suggested_improvement: Maintain the electric fences properly with village participation and pay compensation for crop damage quickly.

problem_description: In the Anuradhapura area, the water in the wells is not fit to drink. Many people in our village have kidney disease. Pipe-borne water from the Water Supply Board has still not reached our village. The RO water purification machine often breaks down.
suggested_improvement: Provide pipe-borne water to the villages and maintain the RO machines properly.

problem_description: In our area in Galle there are unannounced power cuts almost twice a week, sometimes for 3 to 4 hours. Last month the voltage went up suddenly when power came back and our fridge and TV were damaged. The CEB hotline is always busy.
suggested_improvement: Inform the public about maintenance power cuts in advance through SMS. Compensate for damage caused by voltage fluctuations.

problem_description: There is an unprotected railway crossing near our village on the Puttalam line with no gate or bell. Two accidents happened there in the last three years. Villagers have to watch for trains themselves.
suggested_improvement: Install gates and warning lights at all unprotected railway crossings.

problem_description: We have been living in an underserved settlement in Colombo for 15 years. We were promised a flat under the urban regeneration programme but the project has stopped. Some families who were moved to high-rise flats say the lifts and water pumps don't work and maintenance fees are high.
suggested_improvement: Complete the promised housing projects and set up proper maintenance management for the flats.

problem_description: In Trincomalee, tap water is available only three days a week. The water supply is cut off without any prior notice.
suggested_improvement: A timetable for the water supply should be published.

problem_description: Elephants come into the village at night and destroy the crops. Last month an elephant broke down our neighbour's house. The electric fence is not maintained properly.
suggested_improvement: Maintain the electric fence and pay compensation quickly.

problem_description: The dental clinic at our MOH area only gives 20 numbers a day. You have to come at 5 am to get one. I tried three times and still could not get treated for a toothache. Ended up going private.
In Kilinochchi, the road to our village is still a gravel road. In the rainy season the whole road turns to mud and school students cannot get through.
suggested_improvement: This road should be rebuilt as a tarred road.

problem_description: The new education reforms were introduced without proper preparation. Teachers in our school say they did not get training for the new modules and the textbooks reached us months late. Parents are confused about how the new assessment system works.
suggested_improvement: Train teachers before introducing reforms and run awareness sessions for parents. Textbooks must be delivered before the school year starts.

problem_description: The small bridge over the stream to our village in Passara was damaged in the floods 2 years ago. Now people cross on a temporary wooden plank. During heavy rain the village is cut off and children cannot go to school.
suggested_improvement: Rebuild the bridge as a priority under rural development funds.

problem_description: The road in our village is in a terrible state. A bus comes only twice a day. Children have to walk 3 km to go to school. Nobody has listened to what we said.
suggested_improvement: Repair the road and increase the bus service.

problem_description: Many women in our village took loans from microfinance companies who charge very high interest. Officers come home and harass them every week. Some families are in serious debt and selling their jewellery and land.
suggested_improvement: Regulate microfinance companies, cap interest rates and provide low interest alternatives through Samurdhi banks.

problem_description: As a software engineer, a big portion of my salary goes to APIT tax now. Combined with high prices, it is hard to save anything. Many of my colleagues have already migrated. The tax burden falls mostly on salaried people while many businesses avoid tax.
suggested_improvement: Revise tax brackets considering inflation and improve collection from those who are not paying instead of burdening salaried employees.

problem_description: Frequent power interruptions in Piliyandala area. Also bills keep rising.
suggested_improvement: Better maintenance of transformers.

problem_description: went to hospitel at 6am for clinic but doctor came at 10.30. no one told anything why. waited whole day and finally they said come next month. i lost my days pay from work also. this happens evry time
suggested_improvement: pls start time slots for clinic. or atleast inform patients if doctor is late

problem_description: Every time it rains heavily the main road near Malabe junction floods within an hour. The drains are blocked with garbage and soil from construction sites. Vehicles break down in the water and shops get flooded.
suggested_improvement: Clean the drains before the monsoon season and fine construction companies that block drains.

problem_description: In Negombo our pipe water was cut for three days last week without any notice from the Water Board. We had to buy water bottles for cooking and drinking. When we called, they said there was a pipe burst but no one knew when it would be fixed.
suggested_improvement: Give advance notice of water cuts and send water bowsers to affected areas.

problem_description: Last month I went to the hospital to get medicine for my mother's diabetes and blood pressure. But they said several of the medicines were not available at the hospital and told us to buy them outside. It costs us more than Rs. 3,000 a month. This is hard for a pensioner to bear.
suggested_improvement: Supply essential medicines to hospitals on time. There should be a way of giving advance notice about medicine shortages.

problem_description: Our school in a village in Anuradhapura district has had no English teacher for two years and no Science teacher for A/L. Students who want to do Science stream have to travel 30 km to town or stop. Teachers appointed here ask for transfers within a year because of the distance.
suggested_improvement: Give hardship allowances and housing for teachers in rural schools. Recruit teachers from the same area and require minimum service periods.

problem_description: There is no pedestrian crossing in front of our school on the Galle road. Vehicles go very fast and last year a Grade 8 student was injured. Parents have to stand on the road to stop traffic in the morning.
suggested_improvement: Build a pedestrian crossing with a traffic warden or signal near the school, and put speed limit boards.

problem_description: I work as a daily wage labourer in Wattala and earn about Rs. 2,500 a day when there is work. The price of rice, coconut, dhal and gas keeps going up. A coconut was Rs. 200 at one point. We now eat two meals a day to manage, and my children's school expenses are hard to cover.
suggested_improvement: Control the prices of essential food items and strengthen Sathosa outlets. Increase the minimum daily wage.

problem_description: Our school in Badulla district does not have a proper computer lab. There are 6 old computers for the whole school and no internet. ICT is a subject for O/L but students have never used a computer properly. Students in Colombo schools have smart classrooms while we don't even have electricity in some classrooms.
suggested_improvement: Provide computers and internet to rural schools under a national programme and train teachers to use them.

problem_description: Our family land case has been in the District Court for 9 years. Every hearing date gets postponed because a lawyer or witness is absent or the judge is transferred. We have spent lakhs on lawyer fees and my father passed away before seeing a decision.
suggested_improvement: Increase the number of judges and courts, use technology for case management and limit unnecessary postponements.

problem_description: school van fee went up again now 8500 per month for one kid. no proper govt school bus in our area so no choice. teachers also cant control kids in school vans
suggested_improvement: Start sisu seriya buses more in suburbs. and regulate van fees

problem_description: I took my father to the OPD at Kurunegala Teaching Hospital on a weekday morning. We arrived at 6.30 am to get a number and he was only seen by a doctor around 12.15 pm. There were very few chairs, so many elderly patients were standing or sitting on the floor. After seeing the doctor we had to queue again at the pharmacy for over an hour. My father has a heart condition and the long wait in the heat made him very tired.
suggested_improvement: Introduce an online or SMS token system so patients know their approximate time. Open more OPD counters in the morning and add seating for elderly patients.

problem_description: When my mother was admitted to the ward at Karapitiya hospital, one of the nursing staff shouted at her for asking about her medicine time. Nobody explained what tests were being done or why. As family members we were not allowed to speak to a doctor. We felt helpless and disrespected.
suggested_improvement: Train hospital staff on communication and patient care. Have a help desk in each ward where relatives can get information.

problem_description: Our school in Batticaloa has no Mathematics or Science teachers. Students have to go to private classes. Poor families cannot afford this.
suggested_improvement: Appoint Mathematics and Science teachers to Tamil-medium schools immediately.

problem_description: The Pradeshiya Sabha has not collected garbage in our lane in Katugastota for more than two weeks. Bags are piling up on the roadside and dogs and crows tear them open. The smell is unbearable and there are mosquitoes everywhere. Dengue cases are increasing.
suggested_improvement: Have a fixed garbage collection schedule and publish it. Encourage composting at household level.

problem_description: When I went to get a copy of a land deed from the land registry, an officer told me it would take 3 months unless I paid 'something' to speed it up. Many people pay because they have no choice. This is very common in government offices.
suggested_improvement: Digitise land records so copies can be obtained online and set up an anonymous bribery complaint system that people trust.

problem_description: I tried to book a passport appointment online but the website kept crashing and showing errors. When I finally went to the Immigration office in Battaramulla I had to queue from 4 am. The online system is not useful if it does not work.
suggested_improvement: Upgrade the passport website and increase appointment slots. Allow full online applications with courier delivery.

problem_description: Our school has only two toilets for 400 children. The roof gutters are broken, so on rainy days water comes into the classrooms. Many desks and chairs are broken. The children cannot study properly.
suggested_improvement: Allocate funds to develop school infrastructure.

problem_description: In Mullaitivu there are no job opportunities for young people. The fishing industry has also been affected by Indian trawlers. Many people are trying to go abroad.
suggested_improvement: Factories should be set up in the North to provide jobs for young people.

problem_description: The road from Kuliyapitiya town to our village has been half carpeted for over two years. Contractor left after only about 2 km. Rest of the road is potholes and gets muddy when it rains. Three wheelers charge double because of the damage.
suggested_improvement: Finish abandoned road projects and blacklist contractors who leave work half done.

problem_description: Air quality in Colombo has become very bad, especially in December and January. Smoke from old buses and lorries is very thick on the main roads. My son has asthma and his attacks increase when the air is bad.
suggested_improvement: Enforce emission testing strictly, remove smoke-emitting vehicles and publish daily air quality warnings.

problem_description: Education is supposed to be free but we pay for everything. The school asks for facility fees, sports fees, money for exam papers and printing every term. On top of that, without tuition classes children cannot pass O/L. For two children I spend nearly Rs. 25,000 a month on tuition.
suggested_improvement: Control unofficial fees collected by schools and improve teaching quality in class so tuition is not compulsory.

problem_description: With the new digital ID project and so many services asking for NIC copies, I am worried about how my personal data is stored and who can access it. There was news about data leaks from government systems before.
suggested_improvement: Explain clearly how citizen data is protected and fully implement the Personal Data Protection Act.

problem_description: To get a certified copy of my birth certificate I had to take a day off and go to the Divisional Secretariat. Then they told me to come back after two days to collect it. This is a simple document that could be issued online.
suggested_improvement: Allow birth, marriage and death certificate copies to be requested and paid online, with delivery by post.

problem_description: NO WATER AGAIN! 3rd time this month in Kottawa. nobody answers the phone at water board. how are we supposed to live like this?
In Batticaloa, there is flooding every rainy season. The early warnings come late. The relief for displaced people is not enough.
suggested_improvement: The drainage systems should be repaired and the early warning system improved.

problem_description: The Grade 5 scholarship exam puts too much pressure on 10 year old children. My daughter attends tuition 4 days a week and on weekends. Children have no time to play. Many children cry after the results.
suggested_improvement: Make the scholarship exam optional or change it to a simple placement test with less competition.

problem_description: I wanted to start a small sewing business and applied for a loan under a government scheme. The bank asked for two government servant guarantors and land deeds as collateral. As a woman from a poor family I don't have these, so I could not get the loan.
suggested_improvement: Introduce small loans for women entrepreneurs without heavy collateral and provide business training.

problem_description: Forest land near the Sinharaja buffer zone close to our village is being cleared for tea and other cultivation. Large trees are being cut at night. Streams that we depended on for water are drying up during dry months.
suggested_improvement: Strictly protect forest reserves and buffer zones, and take legal action against illegal clearing.

problem_description: VAT has been added to many basic items and services, including some medicines and school items. Ordinary people pay the same VAT as rich people when buying daily needs. Prices in supermarkets went up immediately after the VAT changes.
suggested_improvement: Remove VAT from essential foods, medicines and education materials.

problem_description: When I made a complaint at the police station, there were no officers to record it in Tamil. I had to sign a statement written in Sinhala, and I do not know what was written in it.
suggested_improvement: Tamil-speaking officers should be appointed to every police station.

problem_description: Illegal sand mining in the Deduru Oya has increased. Lorries come at night and the river banks are collapsing. Wells in nearby villages are drying up and salt water is coming in.
suggested_improvement: Strengthen monitoring with police and the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau and cancel permits of violators.

problem_description: Paddy farmers are not getting a fair price at harvest. Mill owners buy at very low prices and the Paddy Marketing Board does not buy enough. After paying for fertilizer and labour we make a loss.
suggested_improvement: Paddy Marketing Board should buy more paddy at a guaranteed price during harvest season.

problem_description: My doctor at the Kandy hospital clinic asked me to do a CT scan. When I went to make the appointment, the earliest date I was given was more than three months later. The doctor said it was urgent. In the end I had to do it at a private hospital for Rs. 22,000 which I borrowed from a relative.
suggested_improvement: Increase the number of CT and MRI machines in provincial hospitals and keep them running in the evening. Urgent cases should have a separate fast-track list.

problem_description: After heavy rains the tap water in our area in Kandy becomes brown and muddy for several days. We have to boil and filter it, and still my children got stomach problems.
suggested_improvement: Improve the filtering at the treatment plant and inform people when water is not safe to drink.

problem_description: Aswesuma money was not credited to my bank account for 3 months. The bank says it is not received from the government. The DS office says it has been sent. Nobody takes responsibility.
suggested_improvement: Provide an SMS or online system to check payment status.

problem_description: I called 1990 Suwa Seriya ambulance for my uncle who had a stroke in our village near Medawachchiya. It took almost 50 minutes to arrive because the nearest ambulance was already on another call. By the time we reached the hospital the doctors said the delay made things worse.
suggested_improvement: Increase the number of 1990 ambulances in rural areas and station one at each divisional hospital.

problem_description: The prices of rice, coconuts and gas keep going up. My salary is Rs. 45,000. It is not nearly enough to support a family of four. We have had to borrow money even to pay the children's school expenses.
suggested_improvement: Control the prices of essential goods.

problem_description: During the floods in Ratnapura this year the warning came very late, after water had already entered houses. Relief items took 3 days to reach our area. Families had to stay in a school with no proper toilets or drinking water.
suggested_improvement: Improve early warning systems with SMS alerts in all three languages and keep relief stocks ready at divisional level.

problem_description: Grade 1 admission process for popular Colombo schools is very stressful. We live within 2 km of the school but still did not get a place, while some families who rented houses only for the address got in. We had to submit many documents like electoral register, deeds and utility bills for five years. There is no clear explanation of the marks given.
suggested_improvement: Make the marking scheme public for each applicant and investigate fake addresses. Improve other schools so all parents do not compete for a few schools.

problem_description: My son has autism and there is no government school nearby with a special education unit that can take him. The one unit we found has one teacher for 15 children with different needs. Private special schools cost more than Rs. 30,000 a month.
suggested_improvement: Set up special education units in each education zone with trained teachers and therapists.

problem_description: I travel daily from Peradeniya to Colombo for work by train. The trains are delayed almost every day by 30 minutes to 1 hour. The compartments are so crowded that people hang on the footboards. Last month the train was cancelled without notice and I lost a half day leave.
suggested_improvement: Add more compartments and trains during peak hours. Announce delays via SMS or an app. Modernise the signalling system.

problem_description: The road from the bus stop to our housing scheme in Homagama has no street lights for about 800 m. Women coming home from work after dark feel very unsafe. There have been two chain snatching incidents this year. We complained to the Pradeshiya Sabha but they said there is no budget.
suggested_improvement: Install street lights on this road and repair the broken ones. Solar street lights could be a cheaper option.

problem_description: I had to go to the office three times to get a certificate from the Grama Niladhari. The officer is not at the office every day. It would be good if services like this could be offered online.
suggested_improvement: Provide local (divisional) services online.

problem_description: Our divisional hospital in Monaragala district has only one medical officer for the whole area. When he is on leave the hospital is basically closed and we have to travel 25 km to the base hospital. There is no ambulance available at night. Last month a neighbour with chest pain had to be taken in a three-wheeler.
suggested_improvement: Appoint at least two doctors to every divisional hospital and provide incentives for doctors to work in rural areas. Each hospital should have a working ambulance.

problem_description: DOCTORS GO ON STRIKE EVERY FEW MONTHS AND PATIENTS ARE THE ONES WHO SUFFER. LAST TIME MY SON'S SURGERY WAS POSTPONED BECAUSE OF THE TRADE UNION ACTION. NOBODY THINKS ABOUT POOR PATIENTS WHO CANNOT GO PRIVATE!
suggested_improvement: ESSENTIAL SERVICES LIKE HOSPITALS SHOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO STOP. GOVERNMENT MUST SOLVE THEIR ISSUES BEFORE IT COMES TO STRIKES.

problem_description: People are dumping garbage at night along the canal bank in Kolonnawa. It has become a huge pile and blocks the water flow. The area smells and there are rats and mosquitoes. During rain the garbage goes into the canal.
suggested_improvement: Install CCTV cameras at dumping spots, fine offenders and provide proper collection points.
